messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired PD-8467 for service=redwood-hosted-api-us-east - severity=page - duplicate_count=3. link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-8467

incidentbot: Auto-escalation triggered: page not acknowledged in 60s. Paging dev rotation.

mia: acked. taking initial ownership — checking error rate and region impact.

devon: on standby, if you need regional failover help ping me.

mia: quick snapshot — 5xx spike started ~12:05 UTC, affects /v1/generate in us-east-1. Error type: kv cache OOM on runtime nodes. Logs show repeated: `KVCache::insert failed: insufficient memory`

samira: seen similar yesterday after a burst; is autoscaler spinning up new pods?

mia: autoscaler did not trigger. avg queue latency jumped but CPU/GPU not fully saturated. suspect batching memory leak + duplicate pages causing controller thrash.

raj: @mia can you post minimal logs and pod list? I can try a hot-restart on a subset to drain bad cache.

mia: logs and pods:
```
[2026-03-14T12:05:21Z] node-3 inference runtime ERROR KVCache::insert failed: insufficient memory (req 1.2G)
[2026-03-14T12:05:22Z] node-7 inference runtime ERROR KVCache::insert failed: insufficient memory (req 1.1G)
Pods: runtime-node-1 (Ready), runtime-node-2 (Ready), runtime-node-3 (OOM throttled), runtime-node-7 (OOM throttled)
```

elena: PagerDuty shows duplicate pages from multi-region dedupe disabled after a config deploy an hour ago. That might be flooding the rotation, causing delayed acks and escalate loops. Recommend enabling dedupe or suppressing region duplicates while we triage.

devon: I can flip dedupe flag to suppress cross-region duplicates. Will do a quick toggle in ops-config: `/ops/config set alert.dedupe=true --env prod`

samira: before toggling, impact assessment: how many customers affected? metric: 12% failed requests for hosted API in us-east 1 for last 3 mins, approx 8K req/min baseline. Roughly 960 rps failing. Customer-facing: some completions failing or hanging. Potentially affecting real-time conversational flows (PLG users).

mia: mitigation plan: 1) suppress duplicate pages to stop noise (devon). 2) restart OOM nodes one-by-one to clear KV caches (raj + mia). 3) temporarily route a fraction of traffic to eu-west to reduce pressure (devon). 4) open incident page for postmortem.

devon: dedupe toggled to true. pagerbot: please confirm suppressed duplicates.

pagerbot: Dedupe flag updated. Future cross-region duplicate pages will be suppressed for 15m window.

raj: starting rolling restart on node-3 -> cordon + drain + restart, will monitor 60s ramp.

mia: node-3 back up. KV size reduced after restart. request failure down to 6% in us-east.

raj: node-7 restart in progress.

elena: customers notified? Recommend status page update: "partial degraded performance in US-East affecting text generation; we are mitigating."

samira: draft status: "Investigating increased error rate for hosted API in US-East. Mitigation in progress (node restarts, traffic re-routing). No ETA yet." Good to post.

mia: node-7 back, errors down to 1.3% baseline. routing revert: will start moving 10% back from eu-west.

devon: re-route toggled back slowly. Monitoring latency and cost delta.

mia: final checks: KV cache telemetry shows healthy, no further OOMs. PD-8467 will be acknowledged as incident mitigated.

pagerbot: PagerDuty incident PD-8467 acknowledged by mia. status=acknowledged.

incidentbot: Incident timeline created: https://infra.example.com/incidents/PD-8467/timeline — assign postmortem to infra-sre.

elena: assigning postmortem to mia + raj + devon. Samira will own customer comms follow-up.

mia: copying final notes here for postmortem input: root cause likely KV cache growth triggered by a request pattern + dedupe config change caused alert storms which delayed early ack. Mitigation: re-enable dedupe by default, add autoscaler rule on KV pressure, and add a small runbook to do node rolling restarts safely.

devon: thumbs up. I'll open a PR for dedupe default rollback and add a guard in the deploy pipeline. :+1:

samira: I'll post status page update now and loop in support for customer emails.

mia: closing thread — monitoring for 30m then will mark RESOLVED in incident tracker. Thanks everyone. :heart:
summary: PagerDuty alert PD-8467: us-east KV cache OOM caused error spike; dedupe toggle suppressed duplicate pages; rolling restarts recovered nodes; incident acknowledged and mitigated, postmortem assigned
